title: Fixed-Size Cells
summary: Uniform packet sizes in SoraNet that equalize traffic fingerprints and resist traffic analysis. All data transmitted through SoraNet's three-hop QUIC circuits uses identical cell sizes, preventing observers from identifying transaction types or participants based on packet characteristics.

tagline: Protects user privacy by making all network traffic look identical to outside observers.
